$comment: THE CAPABILITY INVENTORY — what a person can accomplish in Kova today.
⚠️ OUTCOMES, NEVER SCREENS. 'A coach can see how a client's strength is
trending' is a capability; 'the Progress tab has four lenses' is an
implementation, and writing it that way is how a rewrite becomes a port
It is the ONE artefact that crosses from the old codebase to the new one, and
it is the acceptance contract for stage 7 and stage 8: every line is performed
against the migrated tenant, by the persona named, in a browser.
status: old | built | dropped. A `dropped` entry carries a `why` — a removal
and an oversight look identical without one.

capabilities.why: A discount must be applied by whoever owns the checkout page, and the studio owns it. Kova opens an intent and hands over an address; it never sees the price the customer is charged, so a discount stored here would be a number nothing enforces. Access codes, which grant days rather than reduce a price, are the honest version of this and are not affected.
